sources.text: and stated to others that she had left his house because of a previous promise to divide the time of her stay between elder johnson's house and his own
slackening pace at nightfall to cool my system gradually i finally made my camp and slept as soundly as if on a bed of down
for this occupation in the days of frithiof was considered wholly respectable
